theme: Soft Utility / High-Contrast Dashboard (Light main body, Dark sidebar)

typography.font_mono: IBM Plex Mono, or standard monospace for number plates/data

grids_and_layouts.sidebar: w-64 bg-[#0f172a] flex flex-col shrink-0 text-slate-50
grids_and_layouts.top_header: h-16 shrink-0 bg-white border-b border-slate-200 px-6 flex items-center justify-between
grids_and_layouts.camera_panel: lg:col-span-8 row-span-2 bg-[#020617] rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm relative flex flex-col
grids_and_layouts.controls_panel: lg:col-span-4 row-span-1 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-5
grids_and_layouts.events_table_panel: lg:col-span-12 row-span-2 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col mt-6
grids_and_layouts.status_bar: h-8 bg-white border-t border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between px-4 text-xs text-slate-500 shrink-0

component_strategy.sidebar_nav: Vertical pill-shaped links. Active state: bg-blue-600 text-white. Inactive: text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-slate-100. Include '9x Security' branding at top.
component_strategy.camera_feed_area: Dark minimal container. Absolute positioned 'LIVE' pulsing red badge top right. Centered play/connect overlay when disconnected. Overlay canvas for 2-click entry/exit line drawing.
component_strategy.stat_cards: Crisp white cards, 1px border. Icon in top right wrapped in rounded-full background (Emerald for Entry, Rose for Exit). Massive data numbers.
component_strategy.events_table: Dense layout for maximum visibility. Sticky header. Use subtle striped rows (`even:bg-slate-50`). Status badges for directions: solid light bg + dark text (e.g., bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800).
component_strategy.settings_layout: Left-aligned vertical tabs (Shadcn Tabs with `orientation='vertical'`) for WhatsApp, Account, Security, Updates.
component_strategy.forms_and_inputs: Shadcn UI standard inputs. Focus state must strictly highlight with the primary blue `#1f6feb` ring.

visual_enhancers.shadows: `shadow-sm` on all white cards to lift them slightly off the `slate-50` background.
visual_enhancers.radius: `rounded-xl` for large panels, `rounded-lg` for cards, `rounded-md` for interactive buttons/inputs.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use subdued text and soft Lucide icons for empty lists or missing camera feeds.

motion.hover: `transition-colors duration-200` on buttons, nav links, and table rows.
motion.live_pulse: `animate-pulse` on a red `#ef4444` dot to indicate active RTSP camera feed.
motion.modal_enter: Smooth scale/fade in for full-screen snapshot preview or test diagnostics dialog.

universal_guidelines: LEGIBILITY FIRST: The user is a gate security operator. Ensure high contrast and large clickable areas. Minimum text size for data should be `text-sm`.
DATA ATTRIBUTES: You MUST add `data-testid` to all buttons, inputs, links, and table rows. E.g., `data-testid='camera-connect-btn'`, `data-testid='stat-entries-today'`.
HINGLISH SUPPORT: The status messages and diagnostic texts should accommodate Hinglish casually (e.g., 'Connecting to camera...', 'WhatsApp message sent').
THEME CONSTRAINTS: User hated the fully black theme but accepted a dark sidebar with a clean modern aesthetic. STRICTLY stick to the Slate-50 body + Slate-900 Sidebar approach.
CAMERA UX: The RTSP feed container needs an overlay element capable of capturing click coordinates to draw the virtual line.
JS ONLY: Use `.js`/`.jsx` files. Do NOT use TypeScript (`.ts`/`.tsx`).
